title: Hear the strong beat in a word
objective: Hear which part of a biology word is stressed. Say the word in a sentence.

slides.title: Listen for the strong beat
body: Listen as your lecturer says microscope twice.
Tap each part. Tap harder when you hear the strong beat.
Which part sounded strongest: first, second, or third?

slides.title: Tap these three words
body: Big letters show the strongest part.
Repeat each word. Tap on the strong part.

slides.title: Hear the word in a sentence
body: “I use a microscope to look at cells.”
Say microscope slowly. Now say the whole sentence.
Your partner repeats the word they heard.

slides.title: Can your partner hear it?
body: A: Choose one of the three words. Say it without pointing.
B: Repeat the word and tap its strong part.
A: Did B hear you clearly? Swap roles.

slides.title: Leave with one clear sentence
body: Choose a word: microscope, biology, or photosynthesis.
Say a new sentence with it. Your partner names the word.
If they ask “Could you repeat that?”, try again slowly.
